Fallen Squires have aggro meaning they'll force your units to attack them.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Squire''' is a large enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has high health, average speed and 50% defense, reducing most forms of damage by ~33%. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Squires served as attendants to the kingdom's Champions. They trained restlessly and were known for their loyalty and dedication. When the curse was released, their Champions fell and it drove them to search endlessly for the Templars. On the battlefield, the Fallen Squires are unmatched in combat. The curse gave them the magic they needed, but at the cost of their humanity.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Squire''' is a large humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a black body and wears a chestplate, boots, shoulder-pads and spiked helmet, which are made of desaturated rusty light blue metal with grey framing. It has light blue diamonds on its chestplate and boots and wears dark brown bandages on its arms as well as a ragged brown cape. It wields a sword with a dark grey blade and light blue hilt, as well as a light blue shield with a grey metal frame. It has three random walking animations, one where it runs while points its sword forward and holding its shield to the side, one holding the shield and sword forward while hunched forward, and one tilting to the side while holding its sword up and shield forward. It also has a death animation where it falls onto its back while dropping its sword and shield. ==Strategy== *Decent early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Brawler]], [[Cowboy]] or [[Trapper]] can be used to kill the '''Fallen Squire'''. **Later on, high DPS towers like [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Gatling Gun]] can be used to quickly eliminate it. *On later waves, some '''Fallen Squires''' spawn with [[Aggro]]. Towers with splash damage, such as the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], can be used to hit surrounding enemies despite being affected by [[Aggro]]. **The [[Electroshocker]] can be useful, as its chain lightning will hit enemies near the '''Fallen Squire''', while also slowing it down. *If you cannot afford sufficient defenses, you can use weaker consumables like the [[Grenade]] or [[AirStrike]] to take care of the '''Fallen Squire'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenSquireRun1.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenSquireRun2.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenSquireRun3.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenSquireDeath.gif|Death animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenSquireStunAnimation.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Squire1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Squire2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Squire3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenSquire1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseFallenSquire2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseFallenSquire3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Fallen Squire''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Fallen squire.png|'''Fallen Squire''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Squire''' on a promotional video.
